reviews.text: Terrible app. My app glitches every week and I was told it is my fault from tech team. Yoga instructors are not the tech team offshore.

Great! (If you're only at ONE Location). I have been taking classes from various YogaSix (Y6) studios on and off since 2015. This app works exceptionally well if you are locked into one location, or if you have a pass that allows you to visit various locations. However, this app loses most of its effectiveness when customers do dro-in classes at various locations, like I do frequently. 

Problem #1: Each time I take a class at a different studio the app does not show me my your cumulative classes. for example, I have taken about 100 classes, but currently the app shows that I have taken one class, because it is only pulling information from one studio. It only pulls information from one studio because it cannot pull information from multiple studios. You need to develop a way to show cumulative classes taken that the customer can access, regardless of which studio is pulled up on the app.

Problem#2: Is I have to re-register all
Of my information (INCLUDING PASSWORD!) at each studio. Each time I want to take a drop-in class at a new location, I have to register at that location. There needs to be a way to transport all customer data across studios, regardless of type of pass customers have, or in my case, no pass, but drops in frequently.

Problem #3: Y6 studio employees have no idea how their app works and cannot assist customers (if the app would be simpler to use for dropping students, then this would not be an issue).

If the app developers address these two problems, and then the app would be absolutely amazing! Until then, this drop-in student to multiple locations rates the app 3 stars as it is NOT conveient!

My second issue is that the watch app doesn’t refresh frequently and there’s no way to push a refresh. So if you didn’t sign up for a class 48 hours before, it’s very unlikely the watch app will have updated to give you the option to track it. 

My last issue is there’s no way to see your charges/billing history on the app. You have to go to the website.
